subject: Re: CAIQ owner attestation & evidence sharing consent
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@auroracorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: owner attestation + DocuSign consent request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of AuroraCorp's CSA assessment we need to confirm control ownership and get an explicit consent to receive sample artifacts and owner attestations for the CAIQ crosswalk. Specifically: 

- Can Redwood provide a signed owner-attestation letter for controls in scope (production tenant only)?
- We require an auditable consent (DocuSign or equivalent) that allows Aurora to accept a small set of runtime artifacts (logs, configuration screenshots) for a limited time window.

Target timeframe: 2 weeks from today. Please let me know if you need a template for the attestation or if legal needs to be looped in. I attached a short consent template we use on our side.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Security Assessment Lead, AuroraCorp
security@auroracorp.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: Aurora_CAIX_Consent_Form.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: owner attestation + DocuSign consent request

Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to cooperate. A few clarifying questions so we can scope our response and keep the evidence narrow: 

- Scope: you wrote "production tenant only" — can you confirm the tenant IDs or account names so we can limit logs/config extracts?
- Consent granularity: do you need a DocuSign for the entire evidence bundle or a single owner-attestation letter plus a separate consent to receive artifacts?
- Redaction: we will only provide redacted screenshots or log excerpts that don’t contain customer data. Is that acceptable?

Proposed plan and timeline (tentative):
- Today: confirm scope and signers
- +48 hours: we produce owner-attestation letter (PDF) for the listed controls
- +72 hours: DocuSign link with consent for artifact transfer and a small S3 access window

Attachments we will prepare: redwood-ownership-roster.xlsx (control owners mapping), evidence-sharing-template.pdf (what we typically include). Once scope is confirmed we can populate and send the DocuSign.

If that sounds good I'll proceed and we can track via the HubSpot ticket.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment(s): redwood-ownership-roster.xlsx, evidence-sharing-template.pdf

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@auroracorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@auroracorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: owner attestation + DocuSign consent request

Marissa — thanks, that plan works. Confirming details:

- Scope: production tenant "aurora-prod-123" only. No POCs or sandbox tenants.
- Consent: we prefer DocuSign for the attestation letter and a separate DocuSign consent that explicitly authorizes receiving the artifact bundle (short-lived S3 URL).
- Redaction: yes, redacted screenshots/logs are fine. Please ensure any IPs/user IDs are obfuscated.

HubSpot ticket for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/ticket/HC-12345
I've attached our consent template (same file referenced earlier). Our legal point is Maggie Park (maggie.park@auroracorp.com) if there are any questions.

Appreciate quick turnarounds on the attestations — our deadline is 2025-07-10 for the CSA submission.

Regards,
Alice

Attachment: Aurora_CAIX_Consent_Form.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Alice — sending the agreed artifacts and the DocuSign links below. Per our internal review we limited the scope to the single tenant you provided and redacted operational identifiers as discussed.

DocuSign (owner-attestation): https://www.docusign.com/signing/placeholder/ABCDEF123456
DocuSign (artifact consent): https://www.docusign.com/signing/placeholder/ABCDEF123457

What we attached to the DocuSign envelope: owner-attestation.pdf (signed once the DocuSign completes), evidence_manifest_v1.txt (index of artifacts), and a redacted sample of the runtime log excerpt. We will also upload the full agreed bundle to a time-limited S3 bucket once we have the signed consent.

Next steps for us internally: Kimberly and Jonas will prepare the evidence package and confirm upload window. Please sign both envelopes and reply to confirm when you have the signed PDFs.

Thanks,
Marissa
